transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello Dr. Smith, my name is Yoan. I keep starting school projects and committee work with good intentions but I can’t seem to follow through and finish things on time, no matter how hard I try to stay on top of it. My wife and my department head at the school where I teach actually urged me to come in and get this checked out because it's starting to cause some real issues.
Do you find that you have also struggled with these difficulties in organizing tasks, staying focused, or feeling restless since you were a child, or is this a more recent change in your life?

These struggles definitely aren't new; even back in primary school, my report cards said I was bright but constantly daydreamed and lost my homework, and my parents had to sit with me just to finish assignments. While it has really peaked this past year with my new responsibilities, I can see this same pattern of attention and follow-through issues throughout my university years and previous jobs.

Beyond the challenges with focus and organization, do you often find yourself feeling physically restless, like you have an internal motor that keeps you moving, or do you frequently interrupt others when they are speaking?

No, I don't really experience physical restlessness or feel like I'm driven by a motor, and I don't think I have a habit of interrupting others. My difficulties are almost entirely related to my focus, attention, and keeping organized.
Do you often find yourself losing important items like your keys, phone, or wallet, or becoming easily distracted by external stimuli like background noises or unrelated thoughts while working?

Yes, I constantly misplace school materials like my grade book, USB drives, or stacks of essays, and I spend an embarrassing amount of time hunting for them. When it comes to distractions, it's less about background noise and more that my mind constantly drifts off to lesson plans or other random thoughts while I'm trying to focus.
Do you find that you frequently make careless mistakes in your work, or do you have significant difficulty sustaining your attention during long meetings or while reading lengthy documents?

I definitely struggle a lot with sustaining my attention, especially during long staff meetings or student presentations where I'll zone out after a few minutes and realize I've completely missed what was said. Careless mistakes aren't really my main problem; it's more that I have trouble finishing tasks because my mind constantly drifts off and I lose my focus.
